scenes.caption: Birds.
scenes.say: Zainab hangs a feeder in the garden for the birds.

scenes.caption: A seed.
scenes.say: She plants a seed in the soil and gives it water.

scenes.caption: Endangered.
scenes.say: She learns that some animals are in danger.

scenes.caption: Recycling.
scenes.say: At home she puts her bottle in the recycling bin.

scenes.caption: Water.
scenes.say: She turns off the tap while she brushes her teeth.

scenes.caption: Eid.
scenes.say: At Eid she shares food with her neighbours.

scenes.caption: Kindness.
scenes.say: Zainab asks a new girl to sit with her.

scenes.caption: Small things.
scenes.say: Small kind acts add up to a big help.
